facts.business: Nucleus Software Exports Limited provides software products and platforms (FinnOne Neo® and FinnAxia®) for lending and transaction banking operations to financial institutions globally.
key_risks: Technology-led transformation and changing customer expectations
Cross-border expansion complexity and regulatory diversity
Credit risk on trade receivables and unbilled revenue
Investment in deposits and financial instruments subject to credit ratings
facts.related_party_note: Loan to subsidiary of Rs 272 Lakhs and Investment at amortised cost of Rs 601 Lakhs are credit-impaired with 100% expected credit loss provision as at 31 March 2026.
